scope: Remaining FITNESS location source gap: does a current City of Toronto asset/geodata layer contain an outdoor fitness equipment record (point or footprint) for Biidaasige Park?
method: Bounded primary-source search (<=15 min). Queried City Open Data CKAN (Parks and Recreation Facilities) and the official City Park Amenity Point ArcGIS feature layer (AGOL + gis.toronto.ca mirror), plus an independent UofT outdoor-fitness study layer. Checked local design/wayfinding/map text and recent press. No coordinates invented; no image pixels interpreted by the model.
ownership: NEW files only: docs/biidaasige-fitness-source.md and this fixture. Captain integrates. No runtime/shared-file edits, no commits, no GPU, no bead close.

conclusion.answer: NO current municipal asset record of outdoor fitness equipment at Biidaasige Park.
conclusion.reasoning: The City's own Park Amenity Point layer records 493 Outdoor Fitness Equipment units city-wide (33 created in 2026, newest 2026-09-25) but zero at Biidaasige Park, which has 45 other amenity rows. The City Open Data Parks and Recreation Facilities dataset (refreshed 2026-11-01) lists Biidaasige amenities as 'Dog Off-Leash Area, Playground, Washroom' with no Fitness Equipment. An independent UofT study layer has zero fitness points within 3 km. The Recreation page's 'west of Cableway Canyon' is the only existence claim and gives direction only.
possibleExplanationsUnproven: Equipment not yet installed at inventory time
